Team —

Following up on the AcmeHealth opportunity (RW-ACME-2027-0421). They asked us to kick off ACE registration so they can pursue a co-sell motion with AWS. High level ask: get ACE registration submitted this week, introduce our PDM/PSM to Acme, and agree on a mutual action plan that aligns with their procurement window (end of Q3).

Quick reality check / asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm we have the correct AWS Seller ID and Partner status details to submit (I have the docs but want a second set of eyes)?
- Marissa: can you lead the PDM intro on our side and join the call with Acme next week?
- Rafael: would you own creating the MAP spreadsheet and a short set of ACE registration screenshots (they asked for step-by-step)? I’ve attached a draft MAP.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik confirms Seller ID + any missing artifacts by EOD today.
2) I’ll intro Acme to our PDM/PSM after we confirm availability.
3) Marissa and Acme pick a 30-min slot next week for alignment.

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — Priya

Priya —

I checked our partner portal and confirmed the AWS Seller ID: 1234-ABCD-5678. Partner tier is Advanced Solutions Partner and we have the required business profile filled. Two notes for the ACE submission:
- AWS sometimes requests a 3rd-party PS contact; we should include Marissa and Rafael on that field.
- There’s one artifact missing (architecture diagram with data flow) — I can pull a cleaned version from our solutions repo by COB today.

I can also do the ACE submission if you’d like; otherwise I’ll hand it to Marissa once the diagram and MAP are finalized. Proposed windows for the PDM sync (PDT): Tue 5/18 10:30–11:00 or Wed 5/19 14:00–14:30.

Elliot / Sam / Acme procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick intro on the Redwood side — Marissa Cole (cc) will be our PDM/PSM lead for this engagement and will be your direct contact for the technical-operations side of the co-sell. Karthik (cc) is the partnerships lead and will handle ACE submission logistics. Rafael (cc) will own the mutual action plan and deliver the MAP workbook.

What we need from you to move ACE forward:
- Confirmation of the AWS account alias and the primary AWS contact (email).
- Any preferred PO/billing contacts for procurement.
- A short window for a 30-min kickoff next week (Karthik proposed Tue 5/18 10:30–11:00 or Wed 5/19 14:00–14:30 PT).

I’ve attached step-by-step ACE registration screenshots and a draft MAP. If those look good we’ll submit the ACE package once we have the AWS account alias and confirmation on the procurement contact.

Attachments: ace-registration-screenshots.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

—

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. We can confirm the AWS account alias as acme-prod-aws and primary AWS contact is jon.nelson@acmehealth.com. Procurement looped in on this thread (procurement@acmehealth.com) — they handle PO timelines and will follow up separately on contractual items.

We can do the Tue 5/18 10:30 PT slot for a 30-min intro; Marissa, Karthik, and Rafael are all welcome. Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you include a short bullets summary of what ACE co-sell acceptance unlocks (marketing benefits, lead routing, discount eligibility)?
2) Who will be our billing/contact for future invoicing questions?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elliot
